_readme: Rules for 12_drift_monitoring.py (v4). band_k: width of the credibility-scaled A/E band in standard deviations. persistence_quarters: consecutive same-side breaches before a WATCH becomes an ALERT. forecast_bias_trigger: shown for context (the persistence test itself is in 02). vintage_bias_z / vintage_bias_min: a vintage-bias WATCH needs both |z| above this and a mean bias above this size (z is overstated because vintages overlap). breakeven_headroom: WATCH when a driver is within this distance of its DE break-even (absolute for rates, multiplier distance for multipliers). Judgment values; the forecasting team owns them.
